purpose: Routing manifest for CTPredict narrative reference packs.

include_when: Always include unless the prompt must be extremely short.
The narrative concerns study objective and design alignment.
The narrative concerns quality by design or critical-to-quality factors.
The narrative concerns patient relevance, feasibility, recruitment, retention, endpoint relevance, or whether the trial can answer its intended question.
The narrative concerns participant protection, data integrity, monitoring, sponsor oversight, or site capability.
The scenario introduces many sites, vendors, decentralised elements, complex procedures, or operational controls.
The narrative concerns whether the operational model is credible and proportionate.
The narrative concerns statistical design, endpoint hierarchy, bias control, randomisation, blinding, sample size, or analysis sets.
The scenario changes affect exploratory versus confirmatory interpretation.
The narrative concerns missing data, protocol deviations, interim analysis, subgroup interpretation, or confidence in trial conclusions.
The narrative concerns endpoint clarity, treatment-effect definition, estimands, intercurrent events, or sensitivity analysis.
The scenario includes treatment discontinuation, rescue medication, treatment switching, death, terminal events, or ambiguity about missing data.
The narrative concerns whether objective, endpoint, population, treatment comparison, and analysis logic are aligned.
